subject.title: fix(slack): use endsWith instead of includes for _all_ action_id matching

question: Should this shipped implicit Slack bulk-row behavior become a documented public Slack API, or remain a private producer-owned contract with an explicit upgrade boundary?
rationale: The code fix is technically viable, but repository policy cannot decide whether external producers must be migrated, temporarily recognized, or intentionally broken, nor whether seven new Slack API exports should become permanent.

options.title: Private typed contract
options.body: Keep the marker private, migrate a real typed-presentation producer in the same change, and avoid speculative public exports.

options.title: Public compatibility contract
options.body: Approve and document the public API, make its collection immutable, and add focused tests or proof for existing-producer upgrade behavior.

options.title: Intentional clean break
options.body: Adopt only the new identifiers and explicitly accept that previously emitted implicit bulk rows will remain in old messages.

recommendation.title: Private typed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the marker private, migrate a real typed-presentation producer in the same change, and avoid speculative public exports.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is the refactor that established the affected Slack block-action owner boundary.
